title: quick-exp-log-omar
content:
Mini experiment tracker (personal) - quick log and running notes

Purpose: lightweight place to scribble experiments I care about right now. Not polished. Use this to capture quick metric snapshots and TODOs.

Table: (columns: id | short-name | model | quant | batch | seq_len | seed | prompt-variant | notes | metric(primary) | metric(secondary) | date)

E1 | prefix-cache-1 | rwl-13b | q4_0 | 8 | 512 | 42 | promptA-trunc | testing prefix caching warmup; flaky on long prefix | ppl=12.8 | 95% coverage | 2025-11-03
E2 | beam-vs-sampling | rwl-7b | fp16 | 1 | 256 | 7 | beam(5) vs top-p=0.9 | shorter responses with beam; quality drops on factual Qs | rougeL=0.58 | ppl=15.2 | 2025-12-01
E3 | quant-sweep | rwl-13b | q2_8 -> q3_0 | 4 | 384 | 123 | promptB | q2_8 gave 1.9x speed, small quality dip; q3_0 tradeoff sweet spot? | ppl=13.4 | latency=78ms | 2026-01-14
E4 | adaptive-batching | rwl-70b | fp16 | dynamic | 1024 | 9 | promptC-small | bursty traffic sim, saw backpressure ~pileup 200ms | p95=290ms | error-rate=0.4% | 2026-02-02
E5 | rerank-mini | reranker-v1 | fp32 | 16 | 128 | 3 | rerank-A | quick rerank baseline for re-rank pipeline; seeds noisy | acc=0.71 | latency=34ms | 2026-03-01

Quick calcs/notes:
- rolling avg latency for recent runs (E3, E4, E5): (78 + 290 + 34)/3 = ~134 ms (very rough)
- primary metric chosen per-experiment: ppl for generation, p95 for throughput experiments, acc for rerank

Open questions / TODOs:
- rerun E3 q3_0 with seed=321 and longer prompt to confirm quality delta (blocked by quota on dedicated host)
- reproduce E4 backpressure with smaller batch sizes (4,8) to see knee point
- add internal eval prompt set for prefix-cache tests (need to pull from confluence/kv-cache-notes)

Scratchpad logs (raw) - quick timeline:
2026-01-14 09:12 - E3 run q2_8 noticed stale KV hits; check version pin in runtime (maybe off-by-one patch)
2026-01-14 11:07 - small rerun with seq_len=640 -> ppl up by ~0.6; log saved in /tmp/omar/exp-E3-640.log (temporary)
2026-02-02 16:40 - E4: scheduler spike when client sim > 120 qps; suspected queue growth in worker 3
2026-03-01 08:21 - E5 quick baseline: need to add per-item rerank timing; PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank/compare/feat-timing

Quick commands & links to run next:
- local reproduce: ./scripts/run_exp.sh --id E3 --seed 321 --quant q3_0 --seq_len 512
- infra check: k get pods -n inference | grep worker-3 (when reproducing E4)
- evaluate: python tools/eval_set.py --set confluence/kv-cache-notes/eval-set-1.json --model rwl-13b --quant q3_0

Notes-to-self (informal):
- keep this tidy once a week, archive completed rows to a personal sheet with final numbers
- capture Slack threads: #eng-serving-runtime thread "prefix-cache-investigation" (refer in linked_artifacts)
- might move high-impact runs to project board (Linear) once repeatable

End of sheet.
